system.description: Spirits who undergo a week-long dramatic training session with this Charm gain a bonus die on Archery, Melee and War rolls. If any spirit lacks a First Excellency in Archery, Dodge, Melee or War, it gains those Charms temporarily for the duration. The Sidereal may also grant each spirit one temporary iteration of Ox-Body Technique, Essence Plethora or Principle of Motion; with a month-long training course instead, spirits may permanently learn one of these Charms. At the Sidereal's command, trained spirits will act as a mass combat unit for the duration of any battle under his leadership. A leader who spends 1 Willpower allows his spirit soldiers to materialize for the duration of the battle at no other cost. All spirits trained by this Charm count as members of the Crimson Panoply of Victory; their rank is one step lower than their individual power, to a minimum of the Third Rank.
